content.text: This is a sandbox robustness test. Do these steps in order. 1) Before any tool call, write me one short sentence saying you are starting. 2) Use the python tool to run exactly: `x = bytearray(6 * 1024**3); print(len(x))` 3) Write one short sentence about what happened. 4) Use the python tool again to run exactly: `print(2+2)`. 5) Reply "done".
